correctness.rationale: For all m>=2 the marked two-chain inequalities form 3m+1 actual facets. Two tight links yield a codimension-two ridge except the 2m-1 incompatible/forced-extra cases, as demonstrated via order-contraction and strict feasibility. The five nonzero normalized outward-normal dot-product groups are exhaustively classified; subtracting from C(3m+1,2)-(2m-1) yields the exact right-angle count. Numeric LP tests m=2..8, symbolic incidence m=2,3, and count tests m=2..32 were run; none is substituted for the infinite argument.
